searches_tried: Local comps.py (both databases): 9ct ruby diamond ring, gold ruby diamond ring, 9ct gold ruby ring, plus weight and style variants (1.6gm, three ruby, bypass) which returned no extra hits. One WebSearch for 9ct three ruby diamond leaf crossover ring sold in Australia: no exact match; only Pfeffers snippet and retail listings. Did not run melt lookup or other sites. Gowans small 9ct ruby and diamond rings with no stated weight mostly hammered $140-$275; only rings of 2.9g or more reached $425-$430. A 1.6g ring probably sits around the $120-$220 hammer band. eBay sold listings are closed to us and would help for the stone type.
viewing_check: Confirm the 375 stamp and check whether the red stones are natural (glassy, flawless, uniform colour suggests synthetic or glass), the diamond is present and tight, claws are secure, and ask staff to weigh it (1.6g is only stated). Note size L is small, which narrows the buyer pool.
rate_note: All prices AUD, no conversion needed.
